Don't have an account?

Your password is hashed on the server with scrypt and never stored or shown in readable form. Your session is an httpOnly cookie. This build has no email verification, password recovery or sign-in rate limiting, and runs over plain HTTP locally — so treat it as a working prototype, not a hardened production service.

ElderEase is a prototype cognitive-support app. It offers activities and reminders. It does not diagnose or treat any medical condition.
